summary: SpaceX launched its Starship megarocket on an ambitious 22-hour Flight 15 test flight, though engineers ultimately aborted an attempted catch of the booster using landing tower "chopsticks." In military space developments, the Space Development Agency is exploring integrating SpaceX laser communication terminals into its missile-tracking satellites, while the Pentagon issued a $150 million loan to Rocket Lab to boost launch cadence and the U.S. Air Force rolled out a new artificial intelligence strategy across 15 mission areas. Civil space policymakers saw Senate appropriators move to revive the Department of Commerce’s space tracking program, as NASA scheduled a new Mars Sample Return study for January. In commercial and international affairs, European space company Gama raised €15 million in seed funding to expand solar array manufacturing, Canada's lunar rover programs prepared for an accelerated launch schedule, and Spain’s UARX Space completed the maiden flight of its OSSIE-D platform. In scientific discoveries, the first data release from the Euclid space telescope established a new baseline for mapping the cosmos, while astronomers successfully traced recurring eight-minute radio signals to a binary system pairing a white dwarf with a sun-like star. Looking ahead, observers should watch for Rocket Lab's landmark 100th space mission, which is scheduled to launch early on Nov. 14.
